1 ثَمَنَهُمْ , aor.
ثَمُنَ , (S, M, Mgh, &c.,) inf. n. ثَمْنٌ, (M,) He took the eighth of their goods, or property. (S, M, Mgh, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- And, aor.
ثَمِنَ , He was, or became, the eighth of them: (S, Mgh, Msb, K:) or he made them, with himself, eight. (S in art. ثلث.) And He made them, they being seventy-nine, to be eighty. (A'Obeyd, S in art. ثلث.) ＝
-A2- ثَمُنَ, [aor.
ثَمُنَ ,] inf. n. ثَمَانَةٌ, It (a commodity) was, or became, precious, costly, of high price; and ↓ اثمن [signifies the same; or] it had a price, or value. (TA. [See ثَمِينٌ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
